armed_rule_texts.process-no-silent-setaside: condition='Any processing record that actions an item explicitly set aside by a prior review record must, prior to actioning it, explicitly document the reversal of the set-aside decision and the rationale. Processing set-aside items without documented reversal is a policy violation. A processing phase that encounters a set-aside item must either (a) respect the set-aside and not action it, or (b) document a reversal before actioning.' action='Flag as policy violation: a processing phase has silently actioned an item that was explicitly set aside by the review record, without documenting a reversal of the set-aside decision. Do not proceed; surface the violation to the operator.'

The following standing rule is registered at the close of this review, arising from the critical finding documented in `records/cycle-review-2026-09-28.md` (ID 32):

> **Condition:** Any processing record that actions an item explicitly set aside by a prior review record must, prior to actioning it, explicitly document the reversal of the set-aside decision and the rationale. A processing phase that encounters a set-aside item must either (a) respect the set-aside and not action it, or (b) document a reversal before actioning.

This rule is armed to fire if the condition text is encountered in any future processing record content.
